subject: Kickoff: node-level DP GNNs for interaction-graph features
body:
Deshawn, team,

Kicking off the DP-GNN track. The problem: our recommendation and abuse teams want features computed over the user-interaction graph, and Legal will only sign off if we can bound what any single node contributes. The node-level DP-GNN work gives us exactly that -- a JAX DP-GCN with per-node privacy guarantees, with a clean training setup driven by config files under configs/ and config_flags overrides for sweeps.

Plan: reproduce on ogbn-arxiv first (the download script handles it), then re-run on an anonymized interaction subgraph. Deliverable is an epsilon-vs-utility curve Legal and the feature teams can negotiate over.

Milestones: ogbn-arxiv reproduction May 1, interaction-graph runs mid-June, recommendation doc July 10.

Deshawn to size staffing and data needs.

Dmitri
